verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Reducto Studio, where users can build workflows, "test on real documents with the citation viewer, then deploy as a Pipeline ID" [reducto-docs-34], plus a hosted sample PDF used in the quickstart [reducto-docs-18]. Together these allow pre-deployment testing of configurations, but neither is a true isolated sandbox environment. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment, separate test API keys or test mode, explicit isolation from production data and workloads, and independent corroboration.
